sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Choice Sign Supply is a wholesale sign supply distributor based in Raleigh, NC that stocks sign materials, vinyl, substrates, and signage equipment for sign shops and fabricators.

Industry: Sign Supply Distribution · HQ: Raleigh, NC · Size: <$50M · Products: Sign Vinyl, Banners, Digital Media, Substrates, Transfer Tape, Cutting Plotters

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Choice Sign Supply scores 43 of 100 (tier C) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (16/30) and pain-point alignment (15/15). Nothing was found for event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on weatherability, chemical resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar resists solvents, cleaners and road chemicals without hazing. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (28% similar on vinyl, sign, signage, media); Drytac (16% similar on sign, media, vinyl, print); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (15% similar on vinyl, films, window, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.
